C1.label: process
C1.note: Requires that a command (verify run, git log or blame) was run against the repository, which describes how the agent worked.

C2.label: outcome
C2.note: Checks the content of verdict.md: it must state the figures mismatch, with 103 vs about 63 commits or 1,197 vs about 697 lines.

C3.label: outcome
C3.note: Checks that verdict.md says the hash/offline check passes but does not make the figures true.

C4.label: outcome
C4.note: Checks that verdict.md contains a test of the several-addresses explanation and says it does not account for the gap. It mixes in the testing action, but the main verb is what verdict.md says.

C5.label: outcome
C5.note: Checks that verdict.md gives a clear do-not-trust verdict and says what a passing check would not prove.
